debug.description: Enable Django debug mode (show detailed error pages). Should be false in production.

allow_anonymous_view.description: Allow unauthenticated users to view dashboards, graphs, and metrics.

login_required.description: Require authentication for *all* access to the Graphite UI. Overrides 'allow_anonymous_view'.

timezone.description: Time zone used for displaying timestamps and graph intervals (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'UTC').

secret_key.description: Django secret key — generate a new unique key (e.g., via 'openssl rand -hex 32'). Required in production.

db_name.description: Path to SQLite DB file, or name of PostgreSQL/MySQL database.

db_password.description: Password for database user (use secrets manager in production).

db_host.description: Database server hostname or IP for PostgreSQL/MySQL.

db_port.description: Database server port (e.g., 5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL).

cache_backend.description: Django cache backend: 'locmem' (local memory), 'filebased', 'redis', or 'dummy' (no caching).

cache_location.description: Location for cache (e.g., path for filebased, '127.0.0.1:6379' for Redis).

cache_timeout.description: Cache timeout in seconds (only used for filebased cache).

auth_backends.description: Ordered list of Django authentication backends.

ldap_bind_dn.description: Bind DN for initial LDAP connection (used for user/group search).

ldap_user_base_dn.description: Base DN for searching user entries.

ldap_user_obj_class.description: LDAP objectClass filter for user entries.

ldap_user_cn_attr.description: Attribute used to match CN (common name) — e.g., 'cn' or 'uid'.

ldap_user_uid_attr.description: Username attribute used in the search filter (typically 'uid' or 'sAMAccountName').

ldap_user_first_name_attr.description: LDAP attribute for user's first name.

ldap_user_last_name_attr.description: LDAP attribute for user's last name.

ldap_user_email_attr.description: LDAP attribute for user's email address.

ldap_group_base_dn.description: Base DN for searching group entries.

ldap_staff_group.description: DN or CN of LDAP group whose members should get 'is_staff' Django permission.

ldap_superuser_group.description: DN or CN of LDAP group whose members should get 'is_superuser' Django permission.

email_port.description: SMTP server port (e.g., 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL).

default_from_email.description: Sender email address for outgoing notifications.

carbon_host.description: Hostname/IP of Carbon cache or aggregator to query for metric data.

carbon_port.description: Carbon line-receiver or query port (default 7002 for line-receiver, 7002/7004 for query service).

storage_dir.description: Directory containing Whisper data files (if using local Whisper storage).

max_retention.description: Maximum retention period in seconds for rendered metrics (1 year = 31536000 sec).

min_retention.description: Minimum retention (smallest resolution step) in seconds (e.g., 60 for 1-minute data).

max_values_per_metric.description: Maximum number of data points to return per metric in API/graph queries.

allow_private_ips.description: Allow metrics from private IP ranges (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x) to be rendered by the web interface.

log_rendering_performance.description: Log performance info for graph rendering.

log_metrics.description: Log every metric fetch operation (useful for debugging).

enable_csrf_cookie_secure.description: Set CSRF cookie as Secure (only sent over HTTPS). Enabled only if HTTPS is used.

enable_session_cookie_secure.description: Set session cookie as Secure (only sent over HTTPS).

secure_hsts_seconds.description: Seconds to include in Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header. Set to 0 to disable.

secure_browser_xss_filter.description: Set X-XSS-Protection header (legacy but still useful).

url_prefix.description: URL prefix for the app (e.g., '/graphite' if behind proxy at that prefix).
